pages.title: Crystal of Transcendence
pages.text: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Censer of Entropy, Crown of Transcendence, Echo Lattice, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core, Hand of the Demiurge and more.
